name: 1D Temporal Convolution in Decomposed Space
aliases: Difference of Gaussian Filter along Time Dimension
definition: Application of convolutional filtering operations directly in the decomposed tensor space, avoiding processing the full-size dataset.
summary: 1D Temporal Convolution in Decomposed Space filters temporal changes in 4D volumes using a Difference of Gaussian kernel directly on tensor factors, avoiding costly full-volume reconstruction.
